T30.design: Ridge residual model around current season average + frequency-gated opponent categories + online same-season bias correction + hard stadium capacity cap.
T30.online_correction: Uses only residuals from already completed Lech home matches in the same season. Shrinkage k=3.

T7.design: Ridge residual model around current season average + frequency-gated opponent categories + gated table context + hard stadium capacity cap.
T7.decision: No online correction promoted: the apparent gain was too small and bootstrap uncertainty crossed zero.

decision: Freeze v1.7 as the historical/context baseline while testing league-wide feature transfer and collecting live ticket inventory trajectories.
